# Solvang Guide (https://solvangguide.com)
> Independent 2026 travel guide to Solvang, California — Danish Days, Julefest, bakeries, hotels, and Santa Ynez Valley wine.

## Overview
Solvang is the Danish Capital of America in Santa Ynez Valley (Santa Barbara County). Downtown is walkable along Mission Drive and Copenhagen Drive. This site publishes Pacific Time event schedules, parking tips, bakery notes, Stay22 hotel maps, and GetYourGuide tour links.

## 2026 events
- Danish Days 2026: Friday, September 18 – Sunday, September 20, 2026. Free admission. Highlights: æbleskiver breakfast, Viking encampment, three parades, Friday torchlight procession. Full schedule: https://solvangguide.com/danish-days.html
- Solvang Christmas Julefest 2026: November 27, 2026 – January 3, 2027 (Tree Burn Friday, January 8, 2027). Highlights: tree lighting Dec 4 at 5:30 PM, Julefest Parade Dec 5 at 11:00 AM, Nisse gnome hunt, nightly lights 5:00–9:00 PM. Full schedule: https://solvangguide.com/christmas.html

## Key pages
- Home / hotels / bakeries / FAQ: https://solvangguide.com/
- Danish Days 2026 schedule: https://solvangguide.com/danish-days.html
- Julefest / Christmas 2026: https://solvangguide.com/christmas.html

## Practical facts
- Location: Solvang, CA 93463. About 45 minutes from Santa Barbara, 2–2.5 hours from Los Angeles via US-101.
- Parking: Use free lots on the Alisal Road edge and behind Mission Drive; walk downtown on festival days.
- Hotels: Julefest and Danish Days weekends sell out months ahead. Compare inventory on the Stay22 map (aid=6a77a27277376ac909f8c1d3).
- Tours: Wine tastings and village rides via GetYourGuide (partner_id=Y2EKWLC).
